_about: Your own armband for one gameweek, applied on every refresh (including the scheduled ones) and ignored once that gameweek has passed. Uses FPL player ids, because names collide. Delete the file, or change the gameweek, to go back to the model's pick.

team._about: The team you've set in the FPL app with a Wildcard or Free Hit, for the days before the deadline when FPL's public data still shows last week's squad. Picks in FPL order: the XI first, then the bench in substitution order (reserve keeper first). Ignored once the gameweek's deadline has passed, when the public data catches up.
